about: The source model of a TIFF, BigTIFF or OME-TIFF file (TIFF 6.0, spec/virtualize/tiff.md, spec/virtualize/tiff/profile.md §3): the elements a parser emits, the tags of the table it reads, and the roles an IFD, a value, an image or a tile plays, each with the constraints a file must meet to have the TIFF convention's layout. A parser checks this schema while it parses, at the point the profile meets each role; projections read a valid IR and check nothing.

kinds.about: the field types a tag of each kind may have (TIFF 6.0 §2, BigTIFF)

tags.about: The tags of the table (spec/virtualize/tiff/profile.md §3.1): kind (the field types allowed), scalar (the first value is read, and there must be one), used (read for every IFD an image uses; ImageDescription only for IFD 0, SubIFDs where followed).

elements.about: The IR of a TIFF file. Names in angle brackets are variables; `run` marks where a parser folds consecutive identically shaped siblings into one run.

ifds/<i>.about: the main chain; each IFD's SubIFDs are subifds/<j> (to depth 4), and the IFDs other pointer tags lead to are exif, gps, interoperability or ifd_<tag> (/<j> when the tag has several values; an IFD read before is an alias)

children.tags/<tag>: struct of entry {tag,type,count[,offset][,field]} and value (in the value field, or at its offset: decoded when the profile reads it, or when small); a duplicate tag is tags/<tag>~<k>
children.tiles/<k>: data (run): a tile of TileOffsets and TileByteCounts with a byte count above 0 within the file; geometry, codec and recipe (a JPEG tile's recipe puts the IFD's JPEG prefix, a shared data source, after its first 2 bytes); an IFD whose tile tables are an earlier IFD's names its tiles by alias
children.strips/<k>: data (run): the same, for StripOffsets and StripByteCounts

ome/planes/<p>.about: an OME-TIFF's plane p (in t, c, z order), the main-chain IFD that holds it (OME-TIFF TiffData)

constraints.message: file too short for a TIFF header

ifd_offset.about: an IFD the image's tree reads: in the main chain (chain), or a SubIFD; checked before its entries are read

given.count_within: its entry count is within the file
given.within: its entries and next offset are within the file (known after the count)

constraints.message: IFD offset {offset} is inside the header
the IFD at {offset} is not within the file
the IFD at {offset} is not within the file

field.about: the first entry of a tag of the table, in every IFD the tree reads

given.outside: out of line, and its bytes do not end within the file

constraints.message: the value of tag {tag} is outside the file

values.about: a tag's values as the profile reads them (an integer tag: its first value if scalar, else all; SubIFDs: all)

constraints.message: a value of tag {tag} is more than 2^53 - 1

required.about: a tag the profile needs a value of, in an IFD at offset

given.present: the IFD has the tag with at least one value

format.about: an IFD's sample format (spec/virtualize/tiff/profile.md §3.2): BitsPerSample, SampleFormat, SamplesPerPixel, PlanarConfiguration

constraints.message: BitsPerSample values are missing, differ or are 0
SampleFormat values are missing or differ

integer_attribute.about: an OME-XML attribute read as an integer (spec/virtualize/tiff.md §3): digits, after stripping white space, at most 2^53 - 1

constraints.message: SizeC {size_c} with {spp} samples per pixel is not supported

tiff_data.about: a TiffData element, as the planes are mapped

given.inside: its first position is within the planes

constraints.message: the TiffData elements cover more than {bound} planes

given.mapped: every plane names an IFD of the main chain

constraints.message: OME-XML planes do not match the TIFF's images

subifd_levels.about: a plane, when IFD 0 has SubIFDs (its levels)

constraints.message: the IFD at {offset} has fewer SubIFDs than IFD 0

size.about: an IFD a level uses, or a candidate level (spec/virtualize/tiff.md §2)

constraints.message: the image at {offset} has an empty tile size

samples.about: how an image's bytes hold its samples (spec/virtualize/tiff.md §4.3)

constraints.message: the image at {offset} is YCbCr with subsampling {subsampling}

level_ifd.about: an IFD a level uses, after its size and samples

given.same: its size, tiling and format are the level's first IFD's

constraints.message: only tiled TIFFs are supported; the image at {offset} is stored in strips
planes of one pyramid level differ in size, tiling or format
pyramid levels differ in sample format or compression

image.about: the image's sample type and codecs (spec/virtualize/tiff.md §4.3)

constraints.require: in(compression, jpeg2000) || compression != 7 || (bits == 8 && sample_format == 1 && (spp == 1 || (spp == 3 && planar == 1 && in(photometric, [2, 6]))))

plane.about: a plane's IFD of a level, as its tiles are referenced

given.tables_ok: JPEGTables start with SOI and end with EOI, at least 4 bytes

constraints.message: the IFD at {offset} has malformed JPEGTables

tile.about: a tile with a byte count above 0

given.within: its bytes end within the file

constraints.message: tile {k} of the IFD at {offset} is outside the file
JPEG tile {k} of the IFD at {offset} is too short

translation.about: the image's translation (spec/virtualize/tiff.md §4.4: an OME-XML stage position, centred, or an Aperio corner), when it has one

about_builtins: What the parser's code computes and the roles above check: the main chain (each next offset until 0) and the SubIFDs depth first to max_depth; the OME-XML of IFD 0's ImageDescription (ASCII, up to its first NUL, valid UTF-8, with an OME start tag) and its planes by TiffData (spec/virtualize/tiff.md §4.1: the stepping of DimensionOrder); the levels (IFD 0's SubIFDs per plane; else, without OME-XML, each later main-chain IFD that is tiled, has BitsPerSample, the format of IFD 0, and is smaller than the last level in both sizes); the format tuple (bits, samples, sample format, planar, compression, predictor, and photometric for JPEG); the JPEG prefix (an Adobe APP14 marker for 3 samples, then JPEGTables without its SOI and EOI).
